description: This file defines the internal implementation of a stream consumer extension in Orleans, including the class StreamConsumerExtension which manages stream subscriptions, message delivery, and logging within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: StreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IStreamConsumerExtension that manages stream subscriptions, message delivery, and logging for Orleans streams.

methods.name: SetObserver
methods.description: Sets up a stream subscription handle with specified observer and batch observer, handling exceptions.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes a stream subscription handle based on subscription ID.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Delegates delivery of an immutable item to the mutable delivery method.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Delivers a stream item to the appropriate observer, handling subscription setup if necessary.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of stream items to the observer, setting up subscription if needed.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signals completion of a stream subscription.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error in the stream for a specific subscription.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token for a subscription.

methods.name: DiagCountStreamObservers
methods.description: Returns the count of stream observers for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: GetAllStreamHandles
methods.description: Returns all stream subscription handles of a specific type.
